basic.name: Chain Lightning
basic.description: Shock an enemy with lightning, dealing 170~~0.04~~ damage. The lightning then bounces 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing 85~~0.04~~ damage to each enemy hit.

basic.name: Feral Spirit
basic.description: Unleash a Feral Spirit that deals 153~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in its path and Roots Heroes hit for 1 second. Each Hero hit increases the distance traveled by 25%.

basic.name: Windfury
basic.description: Increase Thrall's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds. His next 3 Basic Attacks occur 100% faster and generate stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

heroic.name: Sundering
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290~~0.04~~ damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

heroic.name: Earthquake
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50~~0.04~~ damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

trait.name: Frostwolf Resilience
trait.description: Dealing damage with Abilities grants 1 stack of Frostwolf Resilience. At 5 stacks, Thrall is instantly healed for 240~~0.04~~ Health.

trait.name: Frostwolf Resilience
trait.description: Dealing damage with Abilities grants 1 stack of Frostwolf Resilience. At 5 stacks, Thrall is instantly healed for 240~~0.04~~ Health.

activable.name: Spirit Shield
activable.description:
Spirit Shield is disabled and will not trigger.

Click this button to enable Spirit Shield.

activable.name: Ancestral Wrath
activable.description:
Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.

Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

activable.name: Wind Rush
activable.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.

level1.name: Echo of the Elements
level1.description:
Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 8 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost.

Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.

Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.

Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

level1.name: Crash Lightning
level1.description:
Quest: Hit at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 4 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost.

Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 15 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces after the initial strike.

Mythic Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning deals 325 additional damage on its bounces, and prioritizes bouncing to enemy Heroes.

level1.name: Maelstrom Weapon
level1.description:
Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage.

Reward: After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

level4.name: Feral Resilience
level4.description:
Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack.

Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

level4.name: Frostwolf Pack
level4.description:
Quest: Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero.

Reward: Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

level4.name: Mana Tide
level4.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level7.name: Rolling Thunder
level7.description:
Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.

For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

level7.name: Ancestral Wrath
level7.description:
Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.

Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

level7.name: Elemental Assault
level7.description: After using an Ability, Thrall's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds deals 45% more damage.

level10.name: Sundering
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290~~0.04~~ damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

level10.name: Earthquake
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50~~0.04~~ damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

level13.name: Grace Of Air
level13.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

level13.name: Frostwolf's Grace
level13.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

level13.name: Spirit Shield
level13.description:
Every 45 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level16.name: Tempest Fury
level16.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage. These hits do not provide quest progress.

level16.name: Thunderstorm
level16.description:
Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.

Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.

Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.

Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

level16.name: Alpha Wolf
level16.description:
For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

Passive: Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

level20.name: Worldbreaker
level20.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Earthen Shields
level20.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

level20.name: Elemental Momentum
level20.description: Basic Attacks reduce Thrall's Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns by 0.25 seconds, tripled against Heroes.

level20.name: Nexus Blades
level20.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

level20.name: Wind Rush
level20.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.
